about_the_game:
Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardcore roguelike deckbuilder with a spellcasting system that enables you to create powerful, wacky spells with unique effects.

Combine incantation cards strategically to adapt to every situation. Will you zap your foes into oblivion, enchant yourself for more flexible future turns or draw more cards to cast a barrage of spells?

Game Features

  • Familiar combat with a strategic twist.
    Easy to learn for new players as well as fans of the genre, while plenty of surprises keep it fresh. Select 1 of 3 effects for each card and mix 'n match to create the ideal spell to get you out of a pickle!

  • Craft the perfect wizarding build. 
    Experiment with a myriad of incantation cards, sigils and spellbooks to become the ultimate magic wielder. The booster pack system always offers options useful to your current playstyle.

  • Explore a dark but whimsical subterranean mystery.
    Entombed deep within the earth, underneath the towering spires your brethren once called home, through twisting tunnels and maddening monsters, lies hidden your deepest wish. Fight your way through the mountain and uncover the secret origins of magic itself.

  • Handcrafted dungeon synth playlist. 
    The underground halls of the mountain reverberate with nostalgic sounds of 90s fantasy-themed synthesizer ambient. We made it ourselves!

Can you make it to the end? Will you find out what happened to your brethren? Are you the last wizard? Bibidi Bibidi!
